name: burst-503-local
_comment: Refusal path: start the standalone target with --request-limit 4 (the shim then answers like the app past kMaxRequests: 503 Busy, Retry-After: 1) and send a 32-viewer burst through the shim's WHEP proxy. Shows the 503 + Retry-After counts of the WHEP tap in results.json and the whep-503-share stop.
